description: Reviewed decisions for the 352 lead cases of revision 2 (2026-11-10). Rules are matched in order (first match wins) on product (regex, full match), property, document and lead list. 'read' says how the page was read. 'comparisons' are reviewed opposite-document values added to the TDS-SDS inventory (tds_sds_inventory.py pairs each with the record's selected technical value).
